title: Central European Cross-Border Cooperation
grammar: Generalizing concessive conditionals: akármilyen / bármilyen ... is legyen ('no matter what / however ... may be')
goal: I can describe cross-border regional cooperation, Euroregions, and infrastructure connections in Central Europe.
I can use generalizing concessive clauses with akármilyen / bármilyen / akárhogy ... is to articulate universal principles.
I can discuss Schengen border elimination, joint environmental projects, and EU regional development.
